31420.a:
```
apt update && apt full-upgrade -y
adduser deploy && usermod -aG sudo deploy
mkdir -p /home/deploy/.ssh && cp ~/.ssh/authorized_keys /home/deploy/.ssh/
chown -R deploy:deploy /home/deploy/.ssh && chmod 700 /home/deploy/.ssh
# /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-hardening.conf
#   PermitRootLogin no
#   PasswordAuthentication no
sshd -t && systemctl reload ssh       # avval sintaksis tekshir!
ufw allow OpenSSH && ufw allow 80,443/tcp && ufw enable
timedatectl set-timezone UTC          # serverlar UTC'da
apt install -y unattended-upgrades fail2ban chrony
```
Tartib muhim: yangi user bilan **ikkinchi terminalda** login qilib ko'rmaguncha birinchi sessiyani yopma — aks holda o'zingni qulflab qo'yasan.
Senior nuqta: bu qadamlar qo'lda emas, cloud-init / Ansible bilan — har server bir xil (drift yo'q).

31421.a:
```
ufw default deny incoming
ufw default allow outgoing
ufw allow from 10.0.0.0/8 to any port 5432 proto tcp   # DB faqat ichki tarmoqdan
ufw limit 22/tcp                                       # brute-force'ga oddiy rate limit
ufw status numbered

nft list ruleset          # haqiqiy qoidalar (ufw ham shu yerga yozadi)
```
Gotcha'lar:
- Docker `iptables`'ga o'z qoidalarini (DOCKER chain) yozadi — `-p 5432:5432` ufw'ni **aylanib o'tadi**, port dunyoga ochiladi. Yechim: `-p 127.0.0.1:5432:5432` yoki `DOCKER-USER` chain.
- Masofadan firewall o'zgartirishda o'zingni qulflash xavfi: `at now + 5 min` bilan rollback rejalashtir yoki cloud console tayyor tursin.
- Cloud SG stateful; host firewall esa host buzilganda ham ishlaydigan oxirgi chiziq emas — SG tashqarida bo'lgani uchun ishonchliroq.

31422.a:
```
df -hT                      # qaysi mount to'lgan
df -i                       # inode tugaganmi (ko'p mayda fayl)
du -xh / --max-depth=1 2>/dev/null | sort -h | tail
ncdu -x /var                # interaktiv
lsof +L1                    # o'chirilgan, lekin process ushlab turgan fayllar
journalctl --disk-usage && journalctl --vacuum-size=500M
: > /var/log/app/huge.log   # truncate (rm EMAS — process fd ushlab turadi)
docker system df && docker system prune
```
Nega `rm` yordam bermaydi: process faylni ochiq ushlasa, inode band qoladi, `df` o'zgarmaydi — faqat `du` kamayadi. Yechim: truncate yoki process'ni restart.
ext4 5% root uchun rezerv qiladi — shuning uchun root hali yoza oladi, oddiy user yo'q.
Prevention: logrotate + journald `SystemMaxUse`, disk >80% alert, alohida `/var` partition.

31423.a:
```
uptime                      # 1/5/15 min trend — o'syaptimi, tushyaptimi
vmstat 1 5                  # r (runnable) vs b (blocked), wa (iowait), si/so (swap)
mpstat -P ALL 1             # bitta core 100% (single-thread bottleneck)?
pidstat -u -d 1             # qaysi process CPU/disk yeyapti
iostat -xz 1                # %util, await — disk saturation
ps -eo state,pid,cmd | awk '$1=="D"'   # D state process'lar
cat /proc/pressure/cpu /proc/pressure/io   # PSI — haqiqiy kutish
dmesg -T | tail             # OOM, disk error
```
Linux load'ga D state ham kiradi — shuning uchun NFS osilib qolsa CPU bo'sh, load 100 bo'lishi mumkin.
Senior: load o'zi metrika emas, signal. PSI (`/proc/pressure`) va latency (p99) — haqiqiy ta'sir. `steal` (st) yuqori bo'lsa — VPS qo'shnisi CPU yeyapti, muammo sizda emas.

31424.a:
```
cat /proc/<pid>/limits | grep 'open files'
ls /proc/<pid>/fd | wc -l           # hozir nechta ochiq
lsof -p <pid> | awk '{print $5}' | sort | uniq -c   # turi: IPv4, REG, FIFO

# systemd service (limits.conf systemd service'larga TA'SIR QILMAYDI):
# [Service]
# LimitNOFILE=65536
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart app
sysctl fs.file-max                  # butun tizim limiti
```
Gotcha: `limits.conf` PAM orqali faqat login sessiyalarga qo'llanadi — systemd service uchun unit faylda yozish shart.
Root cause tekshir: fd soni vaqt bilan to'xtovsiz o'syaptimi? Unda bu limit emas, leak (yopilmagan `resp.Body`, connection). Limitni oshirish faqat kechiktiradi.

31425.a:
```
# /etc/systemd/journald.conf
# SystemMaxUse=1G
# MaxRetentionSec=14day

# /etc/logrotate.d/app
/var/log/app/*.log {
    daily
    rotate 14
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    copytruncate      # app faylni qayta ochmasa
}
logrotate -d /etc/logrotate.d/app   # dry-run
journalctl -u app --since "1 hour ago" -p err -f
```
`copytruncate` vs `create`+`postrotate` (signal bilan reopen): copytruncate'da nusxa va truncate oralig'idagi qatorlar yo'qolishi mumkin; signal (`kill -HUP`/`nginx -s reopen`) to'g'riroq.
Senior: server'dagi log — ephemeral. Asl manba markaziy tizim (structured JSON, correlation ID); server o'lsa ham log qolsin.

```
[Service]
```

`systemctl enable --now app`, `systemctl status app`, `journalctl -u app -f`.
Nega nohup emas: crash bo'lsa hech kim qayta ko'tarmaydi, reboot'dan keyin yo'q, log tarqoq, root bilan ishlab ketishi mumkin.
`systemd-analyze security app` — sandboxing bahosi.

DB migratsiya — eng xavfli joy: expand/contract (avval backward-compatible sxema, keyin kod, keyin eski ustunni o'chir), aks holda rollback imkonsiz.

```
cat /var/run/reboot-required.pkgs      # Debian/Ubuntu
```

Livepatch (kpatch/Canonical Livepatch) — kritik CVE uchun reboot'siz, lekin to'liq update o'rnini bosmaydi.
Senior: "reboot qila olmaymiz" — o'zi xavf belgisi (single point of failure). Har server istalgan vaqt reboot bo'la olishi kerak.

31429.a:
Ansible — idempotent: necha marta ishlatsang ham natija bir xil.
```yaml
- hosts: web
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: nginx o'rnatilgan
      apt: { name: nginx, state: present }
    - name: config
      template: { src: nginx.conf.j2, dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf }
      notify: reload nginx
  handlers:
    - name: reload nginx
      service: { name: nginx, state: reloaded }
```
`ansible-playbook site.yml --check --diff` — nima o'zgarishini oldindan ko'r.
Trade-off: mutable (Ansible har safar server ustida) — tez, lekin drift ehtimoli; immutable (yangi image, eski serverni o'chir) — bashorat qilinadigan, lekin build pipeline kerak.
Qoida: production serverga SSH bilan kirib qo'lda tuzatish — hodisa; keyin albatta kodga ko'chiriladi.

31430.a:
Tartib:
1. Faqat sizdami? Boshqa joydan, `mtr host`, status page, monitoring.
2. Cloud console: instance status check (system vs instance), CPU/disk grafik.
3. Serial/VNC console orqali kir — firewall/sshd xatosi bo'lsa ham ishlaydi.
4. Boot bo'lmasa: rescue mode / diskni boshqa instance'ga ulab tuzat (`/etc/fstab` xatosi klassik sabab — `nofail` qo'shilmagan).
5. Reboot oxirgi chora — avval dalil to'pla:
```
journalctl -b -1 -p err      # oldingi boot xatolari
dmesg -T | grep -i -E 'oom|panic|i/o error'
last -x | head               # reboot/shutdown tarixi
```
Senior: "server o'ldi" — bitta server yiqilishi servis yiqilishiga olib kelmasligi kerak (≥2 instance + LB). Tiklash vaqti (MTTR) — runbook va alertlar sifatiga bog'liq.

31431.a:
Minimal ro'yxat:
- CPU: usage, steal, load / PSI
- Memory: available (free emas!), swap in/out, OOM kill soni
- Disk: % to'lishi + **to'lish tezligi** (`predict_linear`), inode, I/O latency
- Network: errors/drops, connection soni (TIME_WAIT, conntrack table)
- Host: up, vaqt siljishi, reboot-required, sertifikat muddati
```
# Prometheus: 4 soatda disk to'ladi
predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/"}[6h], 4*3600) < 0
```
Anti-pattern: "CPU > 80%" alerti tunda uyg'otadi, lekin foydalanuvchi zarar ko'rmaydi. Page — faqat foydalanuvchiga ta'sir (error rate, latency SLO burn); qolgani ticket.
Monitoring server tashqarisida bo'lsin — server o'lsa, o'zi haqida xabar bera olmaydi (absent/up==0 alert).

31432.a:
```
# /etc/sysctl.d/90-web.conf
net.core.somaxconn = 4096               # listen backlog (app'da ham backlog oshirilsin)
net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog = 8192
net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range = 10240 65535   # ko'p outbound connection (proxy)
net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse = 1               # outbound TIME_WAIT qayta ishlatish
net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max = 262144
vm.swappiness = 10
sysctl --system                          # qo'llash
```
Belgilar: `nstat -az | grep -i ListenOverflows` (backlog to'lgan), `dmesg | grep conntrack` ("table full, dropping packet"), `ss -s` (TIME_WAIT soni).
Gotcha: `tcp_tw_recycle` — o'chirilgan (4.12+), NAT ortida client'larni buzardi; internetdagi eski maslahatlarga ishonma.
Senior: tuning — oxirgi qadam; avval connection pooling/keep-alive (TIME_WAIT'ning asl sababi ko'pincha shu).

31433.a:
Tartib (incident response):
1. **Contain**: SG/firewall bilan tarmoqdan ajrat (faqat sizning IP), LB'dan chiqar. O'chirma — RAM'dagi dalil yo'qoladi.
2. **Preserve**: disk snapshot, `ps auxf`, `ss -tnp`, `ls -l /proc/<pid>/exe`, crontab'lar, `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`, `last`, `/var/log/auth.log` nusxasi.
3. **Analyze**: kirish yo'li — zaif ilova, sizib chiqqan key, ochiq Redis/Docker API, eski CVE.
4. **Eradicate**: yangi serverni toza image'dan qur; eski diskni faqat tekshirish uchun saqla.
5. **Rotate**: shu serverda bo'lgan barcha secret (DB parol, API key, SSH key, cloud credential).
6. **Postmortem**: qanday aniqlandi, qancha vaqt sezilmadi, qaysi nazorat ishlamadi.
```
ls -l /proc/*/exe 2>/dev/null | grep deleted   # diskdan o'chirilgan binary ishlayapti
crontab -l; ls /etc/cron.* /var/spool/cron
```
Nega tozalab bo'lmaydi: rootkit `ps`/`ls`'ni almashtirgan bo'lishi mumkin — server o'z-o'zi haqida yolg'on gapiradi.

31434.a:
```
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 deploy@203.0.113.10
scp app.tar.gz deploy@host:/tmp/
scp deploy@host:/var/log/app.log .
rsync -avz --progress ./dist/ deploy@host:/opt/app/   # a=arxiv (huquq, vaqt), z=siqish
rsync -avz --delete ./dist/ host:/opt/app/             # manbada yo'q fayllarni o'chiradi — ehtiyot!
```
`~/.ssh/config` bilan qisqartir:
```
Host prod
```

Endi `ssh prod`, `rsync -avz dist/ prod:/opt/app/`.
Gotcha: rsync'da `dist/` (ichidagilar) va `dist` (papkaning o'zi) — oxiridagi `/` natijani o'zgartiradi.

31435.a:
```
uptime                 # load average
htop                   # interaktiv: CPU, RAM, process'lar
free -h                # 'available' ustuniga qara, 'free' emas
df -h                  # disk to'lishi
ss -tlnp               # TCP listen portlar + process
systemctl --failed     # ishlamay qolgan service'lar
journalctl -p err -b   # shu boot'dagi xatolar
```

```
systemctl restart nginx
systemctl reload nginx          # connection'lar uzilmaydi (agar service qo'llasa)
systemctl enable --now nginx    # boot'da ham ishga tushsin + hozir start
systemctl disable nginx
journalctl -u nginx -f          # log'ni jonli kuzatish
journalctl -u nginx --since "10 min ago"
```

Config o'zgartirgandan keyin avval tekshir: `nginx -t`, `sshd -t` — xato config bilan restart service'ni o'chirib qo'yadi.

31437.a:
```
# m  h  dom mon dow  command
*/5  *  *   *   *    /opt/app/bin/cleanup >> /var/log/cleanup.log 2>&1
0    3  *   *   *    /usr/local/bin/backup.sh
0    9  *   *   1-5  /opt/app/report.sh           # ish kunlari 09:00
```
- cron minimal PATH bilan ishlaydi — `python` emas, `/usr/bin/python3`.
- `date +%F` -> cron ichida `date +\%F`.
- Ikki marta parallel ishlamasin: `flock -n /tmp/backup.lock /usr/local/bin/backup.sh`.
- Server vaqt zonasi muhim (`timedatectl`).
Alternativ: systemd timer — log journald'da, o'tkazib yuborilgan ishni `Persistent=true` bilan bajaradi.

```
ls -l /var/lib/app/              # egasi va huquq
namei -l /var/lib/app/data.db    # yo'ldagi har papka huquqi (x yo'q bo'lsa kira olmaydi)
chown -R app:app /var/lib/app
```

Huquq to'g'ri bo'lsa ham rad etsa: SELinux/AppArmor (`ausearch -m avc`, `dmesg`).

31439.a:
```
dmesg -T | grep -i -E 'killed process|out of memory'
journalctl -k | grep -i oom
free -h; vmstat 1        # si/so > 0 doimiy — swap thrashing
cat /proc/<pid>/oom_score
# muhim process'ni himoyalash (systemd):
# [Service]
# OOMScoreAdjust=-500
# MemoryMax=2G            # ilova o'z limitida o'ladi, butun server emas
```
Swap yo'q kichik VPS'da kichik swap (1–2G) foydali — keskin o'sishda vaqt beradi. DB serverda `vm.swappiness=1..10`.
Senior: OOM — simptom; sabab memory leak, cheklanmagan cache yoki concurrency. Heap profil (pprof) bilan aniqla.

31440.a:
```
install -m 600 -o root -g root /dev/null /etc/app/env
# /etc/app/env
# DB_PASSWORD=...
# app.service:  EnvironmentFile=/etc/app/env

# systemd credentials (env'da ko'rinmaydi):
# LoadCredential=db_password:/etc/app/db_password
# ilovada: $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY/db_password
```
Xavflar:
- env o'zgaruvchilar `/proc/<pid>/environ`, crash dump, debug log'ga sizib chiqadi.
- `ps aux`'da ko'rinadigan argument (`--password=...`) — hamma user ko'radi.
- `.env` git tarixiga tushsa — o'chirish yetmaydi, rotate qil.
Senior: qisqa muddatli, avtomatik rotate bo'ladigan credential (Vault dynamic secrets, cloud IAM role) — statik parol'dan yaxshi.

```
# 502: connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream
```

33012.a:
```
restic -r s3:s3.amazonaws.com/bkt backup /var/lib/app --tag daily
restic snapshots
restic check --read-data-subset=5%
restic restore latest --target /tmp/restore-test

pg_dump -Fc db > db.dump && pg_restore -l db.dump > /dev/null   # o'qilishi
```
Tekshiruv: haftalik alohida serverga to'liq restore + ilova smoke test + vaqt o'lchash (RTO).
Xavf: ransomware/buzg'unchi backup'ni ham o'chiradi — object lock / append-only, boshqa credential.
Alert: oxirgi muvaffaqiyatli backup > 26 soat.

33013.a:
```
visudo -f /etc/sudoers.d/deploy
deploy ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl restart app, /usr/bin/systemctl status app
sudo -l -U deploy
journalctl _COMM=sudo
```
Gotcha'lar: `sudo vim`/`less`/`find` ga ruxsat — shell'ga qochish (`:!sh`); `sudoedit` ishlat. Wildcard (`/bin/systemctl *`) xavfli.
`sudo su -` umumiy — kim nima qilgani yo'qoladi.

33014.a:
```
systemctl is-enabled app
systemctl --failed
journalctl -b -u app
systemd-analyze blame | head; systemd-analyze critical-chain app.service
findmnt --verify
mount -a                    # fstab'ni reboot'siz sinash
```
Qoida: har o'zgarish persistent faylda (unit, `/etc/fstab`, `/etc/sysctl.d/`, `netplan`). Runtime komanda (`sysctl -w`, `ip addr add`) reboot'da yo'qoladi.
Senior: muntazam reboot qilib turish — bunday "yashirin" holatni erta topadi.

33015.a:
```
strace -fp 1234 -tt -e trace=network,read,write
strace -c -p 1234           # qaysi syscall ko'p vaqt oladi (Ctrl-C)
lsof -p 1234 | grep -E 'TCP|REG'
cat /proc/1234/status | grep State
cat /proc/1234/wchan; echo
kill -QUIT 1234             # Go: barcha goroutine stack'i stderr'ga (process to'xtaydi!)
curl localhost:6060/debug/pprof/goroutine?debug=2
```
Talqin: `connect(` da turibdi — tashqi xizmat javob bermayapti (timeout yo'q!); `futex` — lock kutish; `read` socket'da — javob kutmoqda.
Gotcha: strace process'ni sezilarli sekinlashtiradi — production'da qisqa vaqt.

33016.a:
```
          LB (managed / 2x nginx + keepalived VIP)
           |                 |
      app-1 (AZ-a)      app-2 (AZ-b)      <- stateless, bir xil image
           \                 /
     Postgres primary  -->  replica (auto-failover)
     S3 (fayllar), Redis (session/cache)
```
Tekshiriladigan narsalar: lokal diskka yozilgan fayl (upload) yo'qmi, cron ikkala serverda ikki marta ishlamaydimi (leader/lock), migratsiya bitta joydan.
Health check: `/healthz` (process tirik) va `/readyz` (DB'ga ulanadi) — LB readiness'ga qarasin.
Senior: HA'ni sinab ko'r — bitta serverni o'chirib (game day) natijani o'lcha.

33017.a:
Bosqichlar:
1. Inventar: service'lar, cron, port, sertifikat, secret, firewall, disk, tashqi IP whitelist (to'lov provayderlari!).
2. Yangi server: Ansible/Terraform bilan, eski config'dan nusxa emas.
3. Data: DB uchun replication (lag ~0), fayllar uchun `rsync` bir necha marta (oxirgisi tez).
4. Bir-ikki kun oldin DNS TTL -> 60s.
5. Cutover: write'ni to'xtat -> oxirgi sync -> replika'ni promote -> DNS/LB almashtirish -> smoke test.
6. Rollback: eski server tayyor holda qoladi; teskari replikatsiya agar uzoq.
```
rsync -aHAX --numeric-ids --delete -e ssh /var/lib/app/ new:/var/lib/app/
```
Gotcha: eski IP hardcode qilingan client'lar, DNS'ni hurmat qilmaydigan JVM cache, tashqi tomonda IP whitelist.

33018.a:
```
systemctl list-unit-files --state=enabled
ss -tulpn                                   # nima tinglayapti
# /etc/sysctl.d/99-hardening.conf
net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter = 1
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects = 0
kernel.kptr_restrict = 2
kernel.dmesg_restrict = 1
fs.protected_symlinks = 1
# /etc/fstab: /tmp  nodev,nosuid,noexec
auditctl -w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k sudoers
lynis audit system                           # avtomatik tekshiruv
```
Ilova darajasi: alohida user, systemd sandboxing (`ProtectSystem`, `PrivateTmp`, `CapabilityBoundingSet`).
Senior: hardening bir martalik emas — image'ga kiritiladi va CI'da (lynis/OpenSCAP) tekshiriladi; drift aniqlanadi.

33019.a:
```
ssh -J deploy@bastion app@10.0.2.15                 # ProxyJump
ssh -N -L 5433:db.internal:5432 deploy@bastion     # lokal 5433 -> DB 5432
psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5433 -U readonly app

# ~/.ssh/config
Host app-*
  ProxyJump bastion
```
Xavf: `-R` (remote forward) va agent forwarding (`-A`) — bastion buzilsa sizning kalitingizdan foydalanadi; `ProxyJump` agent forwarding'siz ishlaydi.
Zamonaviy: AWS SSM Session Manager / Teleport — port ochiq emas, har sessiya yozib olinadi, IAM bilan.

33020.a:
Jarayon:
1. Load test (k6/wrk) bilan sinish nuqtasi: necha RPS'da p99 SLO'dan chiqadi va nima sababli (CPU? DB connection? lock?).
2. Prod metrikadan o'sish: `predict_linear` disk uchun, oylik RPS trend.
3. Formula: kerakli server = peak RPS × (1 + headroom) / bitta server RPS; N+1 (bittasi o'lsa ham yetsin).
```
wrk -t4 -c200 -d60s --latency https://staging/api/items
```
Vertical vs horizontal: vertical oddiy, lekin chegara va SPOF; horizontal — stateless bo'lishi shart.
Senior: bottleneck ko'pincha server emas — DB, tashqi API, lock. Server qo'shish uni tezlashtirmaydi.

33021.a:
1. **Triage (2 min)**: dashboard — error rate, latency, qaysi endpoint/region; boshlangan vaqt.
2. **Kommunikatsiya**: incident kanal, rol: incident commander, status page.
3. **Nima o'zgardi?** deploy, config, feature flag, trafik spike, tashqi provayder, sertifikat.
4. **Mitigation**: rollback, flag o'chirish, scale out, rate limit, bitta yomon node'ni LB'dan chiqarish.
5. **Diagnostika (USE)**:
```
journalctl -u app --since '15 min ago' -p warning
ss -s; uptime; free -h; df -h; dmesg -T | tail
```
6. Barqaror bo'lgach — blameless postmortem: timeline, root cause, nega sezilmadi, action item'lar (egasi + muddat).
Anti-pattern: production'da sababni topguncha tuzatishni kechiktirish. Avval qon to'xtatiladi.

33022.a:
Bosqichli yetuklik:
1. Qo'lda SSH (pet) — 1 server, MVP.
2. Ansible bilan mutable config — bir necha server.
3. Golden image (Packer) + autoscaling group / container — SSH faqat break-glass.
4. Kubernetes / serverless — server abstraksiya.

Qachon o'tish kerak: serverlar soni o'sdi, drift sababli incident'lar, compliance (audit), tez scale kerak.
Qachon ortiqcha: 1–2 server, kichik jamoa, kam deploy — murakkablik foydadan ko'p.
Shart: log va metrika server tashqarisida; debug SSH'siz ham mumkin (traces, pprof endpoint).
Principal savol: "Bu complexity qaysi muammoni hal qiladi va uni qanday o'lchaymiz?"
